notes: Row with domain 'canary' is a contamination-detection GUID, not data; exclude it.
The canary row is itself flagged is_bad_source, so usable rows = 998 - 38 = 960 (checked 2026-09-24; an earlier note elsewhere said 959, which counted the canary twice).
Segments are paragraph-level: usable sources average 33.6 words and about 2.5 sentences; about half (46-52% depending on the splitter) are a single sentence.
References and post-edits are human; the dataset contains no MT outputs, so E1 must generate MT outputs itself.
Contamination: released 2025; newer than MADLAD-400's crawl (2022). Models trained after 2025 may have seen it (A5).
